items.description: Fatuberlio is a quiet agricultural town in the Manufahi municipality, known for its fertile soil and local farming traditions.
Laleia is a small settlement in the Manatuto municipality, positioned along the northern coastal route.
Laclubar is a remote highland town in the Manatuto municipality, surrounded by steep mountains and traditional villages.
Fohorem is a mountain community in the Cova Lima municipality, situated in the western part of the country.
The Viqueque area features natural oil seeps that have been observed for generations, highlighting the region's geological potential.
The port at Pante Macassar is the primary maritime gateway for the Oecusse enclave, facilitating essential trade and transportation.
